understood_as: Before launching rare-defect learning, extend the exact finite-panel expected-return calculation to three frozen learned policy families: the original fixed-continuation source policy, the prior normal-kernel PPO continuation, and the prior deterministic p=1 overwrite-adapted PPO policy. Evaluate every seed 30-34 on the same 32 natural starts, derive each policy's return curve from its own fixed-kernel mode paths without assuming k is zero or one, compare all policies and the scripted zero-loss reference at p=0.05 and p=0.30, and perform no learning, policy selection, or checkpoint mutation.
research_question: Does the behavior learned under deterministic p=1 overwrite retain a return advantage when overwrite is rare, and how does it compare with the original and normal-continuation policies before new p=0.05 or p=0.30 learning begins?

original.role: Original normal policy and common initialization for later stochastic learning.

normal_continue.role: Control for 32 additional PPO updates without overwrite exposure.

p1_adapt.role: Policy learned under deterministic overwrite p=1; evaluation baseline only, never a source for the new p=0.05 or p=0.30 branches.

zero_loss_reference.role: Shared 32-start scripted feasible path with no risky harvest; comparison evidence only and not a claim of global optimality.

exact_computation.panel: Each learned policy family uses five seeds by the same 32 natural validation starts. Within a family every seed-start pair has weight 1/160.
exact_computation.path_statistic: For each successful fixed-kernel path record its length T_i and number k_i of valid harvests with positive pre-harvest carried inventory.
exact_computation.formula: J_pi(p)=(1/n)*sum_i gamma^(T_i-1)*(1-p)^k_i over successful fixed paths; the analogous unweighted polynomial gives expected success. No restriction on observed k_i is imposed.
exact_computation.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 grouped polynomial evaluation and bisection; no Monte Carlo estimate enters mode curves.
exact_computation.crossover_interpretation: Any equality point is specific to two panel-average curves. It is not an optimal-avoidance threshold and does not establish that either compared policy is optimal.

validation_gates.all_fixed_success: Every learned policy must succeed on every fixed-kernel mode start before its exact stochastic curve is used.
validation_gates.formula_endpoints: For every policy seed and family aggregate, p=0 and p=1 formulas must match direct fixed and deterministic-overwrite evaluation within 1e-12.
validation_gates.reference_replay: The 32 reference paths must exactly match the pinned prior artifact and remain zero-trigger.
validation_gates.checkpoint_identity: All input checkpoint files are hashed before and after evaluation and must remain unchanged.
validation_gates.execution_source_identity: The run executes from a clean committed worktree whose source hashes remain unchanged.

outputs.per_policy_seed: Direct endpoint evaluations, T_i, k_i, curve coefficients, selected p values, and return crossover against the shared reference.
outputs.policy_comparison: At p=0.05 and p=0.30, success, return, loss-episode probability, risky-harvest path distribution, and pairwise return differences.
outputs.training_decision: Diagnostic evidence only. The separate frozen stochastic-PPO manifest controls any later learning launch.

interpretation.supported: Finite-panel expected mode return of the three frozen policy families under the stated independent Bernoulli overwrite model.
not_claimed: that the reference or p=1-adapted policy is optimal
that a new stochastic branch will acquire the p=1 policy's behavior
that p=0.05 or p=0.30 is an optimal deployment probability
generalization beyond the policies, starts, and independent event model
statistical significance from five learned-policy seeds
